gen-fs-red-hat-display-fs-plein: Bold and marker-like up top, Red Hat Display keeps daylight inside every curve while Plein leads smoothly into each round letter.
gen-almendra-display-gf-fresca: Almendra Display brings an ornate, literary hand with a tall x-height and curves that never pinch shut. Fresca follows in a modern sans with no calligraphic thinning, its short ascenders sitting above big bowls.
gen-almendra-display-gf-funnel-sans: Literary and ornate, Almendra Display varies its stroke like a pen, never pinching its letters shut. And Funnel Sans, a plain sans with ruler-drawn lines, gives that flourish something steady to lean on.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-cascadia-code: Cascadia Code spaces its letters well apart, a wire-thin monoline with smooth bends and tall lowercase. Red Hat Display above it stays bolder and more compact.
gen-almendra-display-gf-gafata: Letters that refuse to pinch shut define Almendra Display. Gafata sits under it with a tall band of lowercase, short stalks, and wide-eyed e shapes that make the ornate heading feel grounded and modern.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-lexend-tera: A marker-like line with daylight in every curve defines Red Hat Display. Lexend Tera answers in a sans with plotter-pen strokes and letters standing far apart, so the two feel bold and spacious side by side.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Tightly knit rows give Oswald its confident, compressed look at the top of the page. But Padyakke Expanded One, a serif with a wide pitcher-mouth c and letters spread out like knots on a slack rope, loosens everything beneath.
gen-almendra-display-gf-geist: Geist keeps a quiet, level beat with no accents of weight. Under Almendra Display's ornate, literary flourishes, its flat single-weight sans lines feel like a plain, steady floor.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-montserrat-alt: Red Hat Display draws a marker-like line with visible daylight in each curve, while Montserrat Alternates crowds its lowercase toward the capital line. Both feel contemporary and open.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-kiwi-maru: Confident and strong, Oswald packs its rows tight and cuts hard. Kiwi Maru, a classic serif with generous letterspace and ring-like o shapes, is the part that lets the pair breathe.
